verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs state that larger models can run on Ollama's Cloud without being downloaded. Cloud models can be called with an API key and no local install, and the same workflow (`ollama launch`, local and cloud base URLs) covers both local and cloud models, which matches offloading when local hardware falls short. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which large models the cloud tier offers and its usage limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud offload experience.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can offload very large models to a hosted cloud tier without downloading them when my local hardware is insufficient

citations.quote: Run larger models on Ollama's Cloud without the download.
Call cloud models with an API key. No Ollama installation required.
ollama launch is a new command which sets up and runs coding tools like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex with local or cloud models.
Learn the local and cloud base URLs, then send a request with curl.
